pois.name: Caffè degli Specchi
pois.description: C'è un luogo a Trieste nel quale sembra specchiarsi la bellezza dell'intera città. È il Caffè degli Specchi.

pois.name: Castello di Miramare
pois.intro: Miramare Castle is a 19th-century castle direct on the Gulf of Trieste between Barcola and Grignano in Trieste, northeastern Italy. It was built from 1856 to 1860 for Austrian Archduke Ferdinand Maximilian and his wife, Charlotte of Belgium, later Emperor Maximilian I of Mexico and Empress Carlota of Mexico, based on a design by Carl Junker.

pois.name: Risiera di San Sabba / Rižarna pri Sveti Soboti
pois.intro: Risiera di San Sabba was a Nazi concentration camp operating in Trieste. Officially designated as a police detention camp, it was the only one on Italian territory with a crematorium.

pois.name: Grotta Gigante / Briškovska jama
pois.intro: Grotta Gigante, also known as Riesengrotte or as Grotta di Brisciachi, is a giant cave on the Italian side of the Trieste Karst, close to the village of Borgo Grotta Gigante or Briščiki in the municipality of Sgonico. Its central cavern is 107 m high, 65 m wide and 130 m long, putting it in the 1995 Guinness Book of Records as the world's largest show cave.

pois.name: Castello di San Giusto
pois.intro: Castello di San Giusto ist die mittelalterliche Burg und Festung in der norditalienischen Stadt Triest. Neben der Kathedrale von San Giusto stellt es eines der Wahrzeichen von Triest dar.

pois.name: Arco di Riccardo
pois.intro: The Arco di Riccardo is a Roman triumphal arch in Trieste, Italy. The 7.2 metre arch is the only remaining part of the city's Roman walls, constructed from 33–32 BC. Folk etymology credits the arch's name to Richard the Lionheart, the Crusader king of England, who is known to have been in the vicinity in the early 1190s.

pois.name: Faro della Vittoria
pois.intro: Vittoria Light also known as the Victory Lighthouse, is an active lighthouse in Trieste, Italy, serving the Gulf of Trieste. It is located on the Hill of Gretta, off the Strada del Friuli.

pois.name: Museo Revoltella - Galleria d'arte moderna
pois.intro: The Revoltella Museum is a modern art gallery founded in Trieste, Italy, in 1872 by Baron Pasquale Revoltella. The baron left his house to the city, including all the artworks, furniture and books it contained.

pois.name: Palazzo della Luogotenenza austriaca
pois.intro: Der 1901–1905 erbaute Palazzo della Luogotenenza Austriaca oder Palazzo della Prefettura ist ein Regierungsgebäude in Triest, in der italienischen Region Friaul-Julisch Venetien. Das Gebäude liegt an der Piazza dell’Unità d’Italia, neben dem Palazzo Stratti und gegenüber dem Palazzo del Lloyd Triestino.

pois.name: Caffè San Marco
pois.intro: Caffè San Marco is a historic coffeehouse located at Via Cesare Battisti 18 in Trieste, Italy. Founded in 1914 by Marco Lovrinivich, it has long been associated with the city's intellectual life, Italian irredentism, and rich coffee culture.

pois.name: Civico Orto Botanico
pois.intro: The Civico Orto Botanico di Trieste is a municipal botanical garden located at via Marchesetti 2, Trieste, Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Italy. The garden was established in 1842 when the city first experimented with plantations of the Austrian black pine.

pois.name: Pastirska hiška
pois.intro: Das Kažun ist eine im kroatischen Teil Istriens vorkommende Art eines aus Trockenmauerwerk errichteten bis zu 30 m² großen runden oder eckigen Steingebäudes mit einer Kraggewölbedecke.

pois.name: Palazzo Carciotti
pois.intro: Der Palazzo Carciotti ist ein Palast aus dem 18. Jahrhundert in Triest in der italienischen Region Friaul-Julisch Venetien.

pois.name: Museo teatrale Carlo Schmidl
pois.intro: Das Civico Museo Teatrale Carlo Schmidl ist das städtische Musik- und Theatermuseum der Stadt Triest. Es wurde 1924 von dem Verleger Carlo Schmidl im Opernhaus Teatro Verdi gegründet und befindet sich heute im Palazzo Gopcevich am Canal Grande im Borgo Teresiano.

pois.name: Museo di Storia Naturale
pois.intro: Museo Civico di Storia Naturale di Trieste is a natural history museum in Trieste, northern Italy. It contains several collections, including more than two millions botanical, zoological, mineralogical, geological, and paleontological specimens.

pois.name: Riserva Naturale Val Rosandra / Naravni rezervat Dolina Glinščice
pois.intro: The Rosandra Valley is a valley centered on the Rosandra River in the municipality of Dolina in the Italian region of Friuli-Venezia Giulia, between the city of Trieste and the border with Slovenia. It is part of a nature park, mostly set around the Rosandra River.

pois.name: Civico Museo Sartorio
pois.intro: The Civico Museo Sartorio is a museum in Trieste, northern Italy. Set in an urban villa, it exhibits ceramics, majolica, porcelain and pictures, typical equipment of Trieste's villas at the end of the 19th century.

pois.name: Museo della comunità Ebraica di Trieste Carlo e Vera Wagner
pois.wikipedia: it:Museo ebraico Carlo e Vera Wagner
pois.intro: The Jewish Museum “Carlo and Vera Wagner", is located in via del Monte 5/7, Trieste, Italy. It was inaugurated in 1993, by the initiative of Mario Stock together with the generous support of the Wagner-de Polo family.

pois.name: Museo ferroviario (closed)
pois.wikipedia: it:Museo ferroviario di Trieste Campo Marzio
pois.intro: The Trieste Campo Marzio Railway Museum is a museum in Trieste, concerned with railway and tram transportation. It is housed in Trieste Campo Marzio railway station, the former Trieste Staatsbahnhof during the Austro-Hungarian period and one of the two main terminal stations in Trieste.

pois.name: Civico Aquario Marino
pois.intro: L 'acquario marino di Trieste nasce a Trieste nel 1933 in un lato dell'edificio della ex pescheria Centrale. L'acquario dispone di 25 vasche, che ricostruiscono diversi ambienti marini, nelle quali ospita specie prevalentemente adriatiche.

pois.name: Speleovivarium Ervin Pichl
pois.intro: Lo Speleovivarium è un complesso espositivo dedicato alla speleologia ed un laboratorio di bio-speleologia. Si trova a Trieste, nel rione di San Vito, alla base della scalinata che divide in due tronconi la via Guido Reni.

pois.name: Museo postale e telegrafico della Mitteleuropa
pois.wikipedia: it:Museo postale e telegrafico della Mitteleuropa
pois.intro: Das Mitteleuropäische Post- und Telegrafenmuseum in Triest ist ein Museum der österreichischen und italienischen Postgeschichte des 19. und 20.

pois.name: Museo del Risorgimento e sacrario di Oberdan
pois.openingHours: Tu "Visitabile solo il martedì su prenotazione telefonando allo 040 675 4699"
pois.description: Visitabile solo il martedì su prenotazione telefonando allo 040 675 4699
pois.wikipedia: it:Museo del Risorgimento e sacrario di Oberdan
pois.intro: Il Museo del Risorgimento e sacrario di Oberdan è uno spazio espositivo situato a Trieste che è dedicato al Risorgimento. Le sue esposizioni coprono un arco temporale che va dai moti del 1848 alla prima guerra mondiale, con particolare attenzione ai cimeli legati alla Venezia-Giulia.

pois.name: Civico museo d'arte orientale
pois.intro: Das Civico Museo d’Arte Orientale in der oberitalienischen Hafenstadt Triest widmet sich ausschließlich der vorder- und ostasiatischen Kunst und Archäologie.

pois.address: 13 Via della Madonna del Mare, Trieste, 34124

pois.name: Lanterna
pois.intro: Lanterna ist der ehemalige Leuchtturm der norditalienischen Stadt Triest im alten Hafen, der von 1833 bis 1969 in Betrieb war. Er gehörte zu einem von der Triester Handelskammer initiierten Projekt mit über einem Dutzend Leuchttürmen an der Adriaküste, mit denen in der ersten Hälfte des 19.

pois.name: Caffè Tommaseo
pois.intro: Caffè Tommaseo ist das älteste noch betriebene Kaffeehaus in der norditalienischen Stadt Triest. Das 1830 eröffnete Café war eines der Zentren der irredentistischen Bewegung in Triest und ist noch heute ein beliebter Treffpunkt von Triestiner Kaufleuten, Künstlern und anderen Intellektuellen.

pois.name: Boteghin al giardin
pois.description: Boteghin al Giardin offers a wide range of fruit, vegetables, pulses, dried fruit, fruit juices and soft drinks. The shop is stocked with products in season and out of season, local, organic or from greenhouses. You can bring your own bags and containers.

pois.name: Giardino botanico Carsiana
pois.intro: The Giardino Botanico Carsiana is a botanical garden located within the municipality of Sgonico between the villages of Gabrovizza and Sgonico, Province of Trieste, Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Italy. It is open every morning except Mondays and the afternoons at the weekend and on public holidays between April and mid-October.

pois.intro: Der Palazzo delle Poste ist ein Palast aus dem 19. Jahrhundert in Triest in der italienischen Region Friaul-Julisch Venetien.

pois.name: Molo Audace
pois.intro: Molo Audace is a pier located on the shores of Trieste, Italy right in the centre of the city, a few steps from Piazza Unità d'Italia and the Grand Canal. It separates the San Giorgio basin from the San Giusto basin of the Old Port.

pois.name: Villa Necker
pois.intro: Die Villa Necker ist ein klassizistisches Landhaus in Triest in der italienischen Region Friaul-Julisch Venetien. Sie liegt in der Via dell’Università 2.

pois.name: Palazzo Rittmeyer
pois.intro: Der Palazzo Rittmeyer ist ein Palast aus dem 19. Jahrhundert in Triest in der italienischen Region Friaul-Julisch Venetien.
